# Design

Add a feature-level [documentation] state to the normative KVX rather than manufacturing a numeric task. Model it internally as the reserved @docs work item so existing work packets, leases, orchestrator drivers, MCP, and editor flows can reuse it. Add a dependency-free docs module that discovers canonical targets, freezes a pre-documentation evidence baseline from spec trace, snapshots, graph queries, routes, anchors, memories, and verification outcomes, and writes a derived claim ledger under .codegraph/docs. cg spec done only makes @docs eligible; the orchestrator or connected interactive agent performs the work. cg docs plan, packet, status, check, and trace expose the lifecycle. Deterministic checks gate closure, and successful closure receives its own task-attributed Codify snapshot. New specs enable auto mode by default; legacy specs remain compatible until explicitly enabled.
